src/lib/components/EventCalendar.react.j.description:
EventCalendar is a day / week / month / agenda calendar for displaying and
editing events, wrapping the MUI X `EventCalendar` (Community, MIT). Events
cross the Dash boundary as plain dicts with ISO-string dates; user edits
(create / move / resize / delete) round-trip back through the `events` prop.

id.description: The id used to identify this component in Dash callbacks.

className.description: CSS class applied to the wrapping div.

height.description: Height of the wrapping container (the calendar fills it). Default 600.

sx.description: MUI `sx` styling object applied to the calendar (object form only).

start.name: string
start.description: Start date-time, ISO string. "Z" suffix = UTC instant.

end.name: string
end.description: End date-time, ISO string. "Z" suffix = UTC instant.

description.name: string
description.description: Optional longer description (shown in the event dialog).

timezone.name: string
timezone.description: IANA timezone the wall-time start/end are interpreted in.

resource.name: union
resource.description: Id of the resource this event belongs to.

rrule.name: union
rrule.description:
Recurrence rule — an RFC-5545 RRULE string
("FREQ=WEEKLY;INTERVAL=2;BYDAY=TH") or an object
{freq, interval, byDay, byMonthDay, byMonth, count, until}.
Recurrence is a Premium feature (use EventCalendarPremium).

exDates.name: arrayOf
exDates.description: Exception dates (ISO strings) excluded from the recurrence.

allDay.name: bool
allDay.description: Whether the event spans the whole day.

readOnly.name: bool
readOnly.description: Whether the event cannot be edited / dragged / resized.

resizable.name: union
resizable.description: Per-event resize override (bool or which edge).

className.name: string
className.description: Custom CSS class for the event element.

extractedFromId.name: union
extractedFromId.description: Id of the event this one was split from.

events.description:
The events to render. Each event is a dict with at least `id`, `title`,
`start` and `end` (ISO strings). This is BOTH an input and an output:
the calendar writes the full array back on every create / edit / move /
resize / delete.

eventColor.description:
The default color palette used for all events. Overridden per resource
(`eventColor`) and per event (`color`). Default "teal".

eventCreation.description:
Configures event creation. `false` disables it; `true` enables it with
defaults; an object sets the interaction and default duration (minutes).

resources.description: Resources events can be assigned to (supports nested `children`).

visibleResources.description: Controlled resource visibility map {resourceId: bool}. Also an OUTPUT.

defaultVisibleResources.description: Uncontrolled initial resource visibility map. Default {} (all visible).

shouldEventRequireResource.description: Require every event to be assigned to a resource. Default false.

view.description: Controlled active view. Also an OUTPUT (updated on view change).

visibleDate.description:
Controlled visible date (ISO string). Drives which date range is shown.
Also an OUTPUT — written back (ISO string) when the user navigates.

defaultVisibleDate.description: Uncontrolled initial visible date (ISO string). Default today.

areEventsResizable.description: Allow resize (bool, or restrict to "start"/"end"). Default true.

canDragEventsFromTheOutside.description: Allow external events to be dragged in. Default false.

canDropEventsToTheOutside.description: Allow events to be dragged out of the calendar. Default false.

readOnly.description: Global read-only mode (disables create / drag / resize / dialog).

showCurrentTimeIndicator.description: Show the current-time indicator line in time views. Default true.

displayTimezone.description:
Timezone used to render events: an IANA name
("America/New_York"), or "default" / "locale" / "UTC". Render-only —
events keep their own data timezone. Default "default".

preferences.description:
Controlled user preferences. Also an OUTPUT.
{ampm, weekStartsOn (0=Sun..6=Sat), showWeekends, showWeekNumber,
 isSidePanelOpen, showEmptyDaysInAgenda}.

preferencesMenuConfig.description: Which items appear in the preferences menu, or `false` to hide the menu.

localeText.description: Override UI label strings (a partial map of translation keys).

eventDialogVariant.description:
How the event editor is presented. "drawer" (default) restyles the
built-in dialog into a responsive drawer — right-anchored on desktop, an
80%-height bottom sheet on mobile (below `mobileBreakpoint`), with a
scrollable body and pinned header/actions. "dialog" keeps the library's
default floating, draggable dialog.

responsiveSidePanel.description:
When true (default), the side panel starts open on wide screens and
collapsed below `mobileBreakpoint` on first render — unless you pin
`isSidePanelOpen` via `preferences` / `defaultPreferences`.

scrollToCurrentTime.description:
In the day / week views, scroll the time grid on first render (and on
view change) so the current-time indicator is centered in view. Pairs
with `showCurrentTimeIndicator`. Default false.

mobileBreakpoint.description: Width (px) below which the UI switches to its mobile layout. Default 768.

eventDialogTopOffset.description:
On desktop, inset the event drawer this many px from the top — e.g. set
it to your fixed app header's height so the drawer lines up with a
sidebar instead of covering the header. Default 0.

lastAction.description:
Convenience OUTPUT describing the most recent change to `events`:
{type: "create"|"update"|"delete"|"move"|"resize"|"change",
 event: the affected event (or null), event_timestamp}.

setProps.description: Dash-assigned callback to report prop changes.

src/lib/components/EventCalendarPremium..description:
EventCalendarPremium is the Event Calendar with the MUI X Premium recurrence
engine: events can carry an `rrule` (RFC-5545 string or object) and
`exDates`, and the edit dialog gains a Recurrence tab. Requires a MUI X
Premium license key (the `licenseKey` prop) to render without a watermark.

id.description: The id used to identify this component in Dash callbacks.

className.description: CSS class applied to the wrapping div.

height.description: Height of the wrapping container (the calendar fills it). Default 600.

sx.description: MUI `sx` styling object applied to the calendar (object form only).

licenseKey.description:
MUI X Premium license key. Set once to remove the watermark and unlock
Premium features (recurrence). Read from an environment variable on the
server and pass it in.

rrule.name: union
rrule.description:
Recurrence rule — RFC-5545 RRULE string
("FREQ=WEEKLY;INTERVAL=2;BYDAY=TH") or an object
{freq:"DAILY|WEEKLY|MONTHLY|YEARLY", interval, byDay, byMonthDay,
 byMonth, count, until}.

exDates.name: arrayOf
exDates.description: Exception dates (ISO strings) excluded from the recurrence.

events.description:
The events to render. Each event is a dict with at least `id`, `title`,
`start`, `end` (ISO strings). Premium events may also carry `rrule`
(recurrence) and `exDates`. INPUT + OUTPUT (round-trips on every change).

eventColor.description: Default color palette for all events (overridable). Default "teal".

eventCreation.description:
Configures event creation. `false` disables it; `true` enables defaults;

resources.description: Resources events can be assigned to (supports nested `children`).

shouldEventRequireResource.description: Require every event to be assigned to a resource. Default false.

view.description: Controlled active view. Also an OUTPUT.

visibleDate.description: Controlled visible date (ISO string). Also an OUTPUT.

defaultVisibleDate.description: Uncontrolled initial visible date (ISO string). Default today.

areEventsResizable.description: Allow resize (bool, or restrict to "start"/"end"). Default true.

canDragEventsFromTheOutside.description: Allow external events to be dragged in. Default false.

canDropEventsToTheOutside.description: Allow events to be dragged out of the calendar. Default false.

readOnly.description: Global read-only mode (disables create / drag / resize / dialog).

showCurrentTimeIndicator.description: Show the current-time indicator line in time views. Default true.

displayTimezone.description: Render timezone: IANA name, or "default"/"locale"/"UTC". Default "default".

preferences.description: Controlled user preferences. Also an OUTPUT.

preferencesMenuConfig.description: Which items appear in the preferences menu, or `false` to hide it.

localeText.description: Override UI label strings (a partial map of translation keys).

eventDialogVariant.description:
How the event editor is presented. "drawer" (default) restyles the
built-in dialog into a responsive drawer — right-anchored on desktop, an
80%-height bottom sheet on mobile (below `mobileBreakpoint`), with a
scrollable body and pinned header/actions. "dialog" keeps the library's
default floating, draggable dialog.

When true (default), the side panel starts open on wide screens and

scrollToCurrentTime.description:
In the day / week views, scroll the time grid on first render (and on

mobileBreakpoint.description: Width (px) below which the UI switches to its mobile layout. Default 768.

eventDialogTopOffset.description:
On desktop, inset the event drawer this many px from the top — e.g. set
it to your fixed app header's height so the drawer lines up with a
sidebar instead of covering the header. Default 0.

lastAction.description:
Convenience OUTPUT describing the most recent change to `events`:
{type, event, event_timestamp}.

setProps.description: Dash-assigned callback to report prop changes.

src/lib/components/EventTimeline.react.j.description:
EventTimeline is a resource-row, Gantt-style timeline that places events on
the row of the resource they are assigned to, across configurable zoom
presets, wrapping the MUI X `EventTimelinePremium`. Requires a MUI X Premium
license key (the `licenseKey` prop) to render without a watermark.

id.description: The id used to identify this component in Dash callbacks.

className.description: CSS class applied to the wrapping div.

height.description: Height of the wrapping container (the timeline fills it). Default 400.

sx.description: MUI `sx` styling object applied to the timeline (object form only).

licenseKey.description: MUI X Premium license key (removes the watermark).

events.description:
Allocation bars. Each event needs `id`, `title`, `start`, `end` (ISO
strings) and usually a `resource` (the row it sits on). INPUT + OUTPUT.

eventColor.description: Default color palette for all events (overridable). Default "teal".

eventCreation.description:
Configures event creation. `false` disables it; `true` enables defaults;
an object sets {interaction, duration (minutes)}.

resources.description: The resource rows. Each event's `resource` points to one of these ids.

resourceColumnLabel.description: Label shown in the resource column header.

visibleResources.description: Controlled resource visibility map {resourceId: bool}. Also an OUTPUT.

defaultVisibleResources.description: Uncontrolled initial resource visibility map. Default {} (all visible).

shouldEventRequireResource.description: Require every event to be assigned to a resource. Default true (timeline).

preset.description:
Controlled zoom preset. Also an OUTPUT. One of
"dayAndHour" | "dayAndMonth" | "dayAndWeek" | "monthAndYear" | "year".

presets.description:
The presets available (zoom levels offered). Default is all five, from
most zoomed-in to most zoomed-out.

visibleDate.description: Controlled visible date (ISO string) — centers the window. Also OUTPUT.

defaultVisibleDate.description: Uncontrolled initial visible date (ISO string). Default today.

areEventsResizable.description: Allow resize (bool, or restrict to "start"/"end"). Default true.

canDragEventsFromTheOutside.description: Allow external events to be dragged in. Default false.

canDropEventsToTheOutside.description: Allow events to be dragged out of the timeline. Default false.

showCurrentTimeIndicator.description: Show the current-time indicator line. Default true.

displayTimezone.description: Render timezone: IANA name, or "default"/"locale"/"UTC". Default "default".

preferences.description: Controlled preferences {ampm, weekStartsOn}. Also an OUTPUT.

defaultPreferences.description: Uncontrolled initial preferences {ampm, weekStartsOn}. Default {ampm: true}.

localeText.description: Override UI label strings (a partial map of translation keys).

eventDialogVariant.description:
How the event editor is presented. "drawer" (default) restyles the
built-in dialog into a responsive frosted-glass drawer — right-anchored
on desktop, an 88%-height bottom sheet on mobile (below
`mobileBreakpoint`). "dialog" keeps the library's floating dialog.

mobileBreakpoint.description: Width (px) below which the editor uses its mobile layout. Default 768.

eventDialogTopOffset.description:
On desktop, inset the event drawer this many px from the top — e.g. set
it to your fixed app header's height. Default 0.

lastAction.description: Convenience OUTPUT describing the most recent change to `events`.

setProps.description: Dash-assigned callback to report prop changes.

src/lib/components/RadialBarChart.react..description:
RadialBarChart compares values along periodic categories using polar bars.
Series accept `stack` and `layout` ("vertical" = radius encodes the value,
"horizontal" = rotation encodes it); the band rotation axis accepts
`categoryGapRatio` / `barGapRatio`. Clicking reports the hit item via the
`clickData` output. Premium (preview) — set `licenseKey`.

id.description: The id used to identify this component in Dash callbacks.

className.description: CSS class applied to the wrapping div.

width.description: Chart width in px (defaults to filling the container).

licenseKey.description: MUI X Premium license key (removes the watermark).

series.description:
The bar series to plot. Each item is a dict, e.g.
{dataKey, label, stack, layout:"vertical"|"horizontal", color} or
{data: [...], label, ...}.

dataset.description: Row-oriented data; series reference columns via `dataKey`.

rotationAxis.description:
Rotation (angular) axis config — replaces the cartesian x-axis. A list of
axis dicts. A band axis accepts `categoryGapRatio` / `barGapRatio`, e.g.
[{scaleType:"band", data:["2020","2021"], categoryGapRatio:0.3, barGapRatio:0.1}].

radiusAxis.description: Radius axis config — replaces the cartesian y-axis. A list of axis dicts.

grid.description: Show background grid lines: {rotation: bool, radius: bool}.

axisHighlight.description:
Axis highlight behavior: {rotation, radius} where each is one of
"none" | "line" | "band". Default depends on the layout.

margin.description: Margin around the plot — a number or {top,right,bottom,left}.

colors.description: Color palette (list of CSS colors) used for the series.

slotProps.description: MUI X charts `slotProps` (plain-object form only), e.g. {"tooltip": {"trigger": "item"}}.

clickData.description:
OUTPUT — set when the user clicks the chart. The clicked axis item and
its series values, e.g. {dataIndex, axisValue, seriesValues, event_timestamp}.

setProps.description: Dash-assigned callback to report prop changes.

src/lib/components/RadialLineChart.react.description:
RadialLineChart shows trends along periodic values using a polar line (or
area) plot. Pass `series` plus `rotationAxis` / `radiusAxis` to map your data
into polar coordinates; clicking the chart reports the hit axis item via the
`clickData` output. Premium (preview) — set `licenseKey` to remove the
watermark.

id.description: The id used to identify this component in Dash callbacks.

className.description: CSS class applied to the wrapping div.

width.description: Chart width in px (defaults to filling the container).

licenseKey.description: MUI X Premium license key (removes the watermark).

series.description:
The line/area series to plot. Each item is a dict, e.g.
{dataKey, label, curve, showMark, shape, area, closePath, stack,
 highlightScope, color} or {data: [...], label, ...}.

dataset.description: Row-oriented data; series reference columns via `dataKey`.

rotationAxis.description:
Rotation (angular) axis config — replaces the cartesian x-axis. A list of
axis dicts, e.g. [{scaleType:"point", dataKey:"month", disableLine:true}].

radiusAxis.description:
Radius axis config — replaces the cartesian y-axis. A list of axis dicts,
e.g. [{disableLine:true, minRadius:10, min:0, position:"none"}].

grid.description: Show background grid lines: {rotation: bool, radius: bool}.

axisHighlight.description:
Axis highlight behavior: {rotation, radius} where each is one of
"none" | "line" | "band". Default {rotation: "line"}.

margin.description: Margin around the plot — a number or {top,right,bottom,left}.

colors.description: Color palette (list of CSS colors) used for the series.

disableLineItemHighlight.description: Disable the per-item line highlight indicator.

slotProps.description:
MUI X charts `slotProps` (plain-object form only). For example
{"tooltip": {"trigger": "item"}} makes the tooltip follow the hovered
mark/line instead of the whole rotation axis.

clickData.description:
OUTPUT — set when the user clicks the chart. The clicked rotation-axis
item and its series values, e.g.
{dataIndex, axisValue, seriesValues, event_timestamp}.

setProps.description: Dash-assigned callback to report prop changes.
